# HPCC Systems

> HPCC Systems is an open-source, cloud-native big-data platform featuring the ECL programming language, Kubernetes deployment, and machine learning capabilities for enterprise data engineering.

HPCC Systems provides a comprehensive data engineering platform with distributed processing engines (Thor and Roxie), containerized deployment via Kubernetes and Helm, and extensive training resources. The platform is maintained by LexisNexis Risk Solutions and supports both cloud-native and bare-metal deployments.

## Key Topics

- ECL (Enterprise Control Language)
- HPCC Systems Platform
- Thor (distributed processing engine)
- Roxie (query engine)
- Kubernetes
- Cloud-native architecture
- Docker containerization
- Helm charts
- Machine Learning Library
- Big-data processing
- Data transformation
- ECL IDE
- Terraform deployment
- Community Edition
- High-performance computing

## Getting Started & Installation

- [Getting Started](https://hpccsystems.com/getting-started): Installation and setup guide for HPCC Systems using Docker Desktop and Minikube
- [Deploy](https://hpccsystems.com/downloads): HPCC Systems Platform v10.2 deployment guide using Helm, Terraform, and Kubernetes
- [Deploy](https://hpccsystems.com/download): HPCC Systems Platform v10.2 installation and deployment options for cloud and bare-metal

- [Cloud Native Containerized Platform](https://hpccsystems.com/training/documentation/cloud-native-containerized-platform): Docker and Kubernetes deployment guide for HPCC Systems with Helm charts
